summary: Reproduced character-prefix word revisions emitting mid-word suffixes and punctuation deltas gaining a prompt-space. Made append-only detection boundary-aware, preserved whole-word rollback state, and reused punctuation-aware spacing for the emitted prompt accumulator.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression on the recorded base: exact word-extension reproduction emitted erpillar, punctuation accumulated as hello world comma-with-space, and temporary rollback repeated gamma. One independent normal-append boundary passed.
Passing-after focused state regressions plus related transcription and audio-chunking unit coverage: 31 passed.
All applicable repository formatting, lint, spelling, and registered-test validation hooks passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: The reported failure was reproduced without inference in StreamingASRState's deterministic Python string transitions; no GPU operation is relevant to the correction.

remaining_limitations: No Qwen3-ASR model weights were used, so model transcription quality and architecture-specific inference were not validated.
No live HTTP SSE or realtime WebSocket server was launched; the shared state implementation and existing related serving unit tests were exercised directly.
The existing documented limitation for whitespace-free CJK rollback remains unchanged.
